reviews.text:
A true cat whisperer 🙏🏼 Very good experience with my intensely anxious tomcat Davey❣️ Marie has a special, reassuring energy and she is very sweet and gentle. I felt that immediately, and so did Davey; whereas I had expected anesthesia, he allowed his back to be shaved bald. So thankfully no sedation, and his knots were gone without any trauma❣️
Thank you so much, Marie, also on behalf of Davey❣️

Absolutely adorable lady, and so kind to the cats! 🙏🏼 we have been already twice with my cat for the grooming, will come again ❤️ thank you for your cute gift afterwards to Fuji 🖤🥹 …
So happy with Marie! Our Coon, Gaia, is too.

What a lovely grooming salon. My cat, who wants nothing to do with being combed at home and had consequently developed quite large knots, barely flinched on the grooming table. An incredibly relaxed and loving grooming salon.
Highly recommended! Marie is incredibly experienced and has a real love for animals. So happy :)
